text: Chanting of David in his fleeing from the face of Absalom his son. Jehovah, how they pressing upon me were multiplied! many rising up against me.
Many saying to my soul, No salvation to him in God. Silence.
And thou, Jehovah, a shield about me: my glory, and lifting up my head.
With my voice will I call to Jehovah, and he will answer me from his holy mountain. Silence.
I lay down and I, shall sleep; I awaked: for Jehovah will uphold me.
I shall not be afraid of ten thousand of people who sit round about upon me.
Arise, O Jehovah; save me, my God, for thou didst strike all mine enemies upon the cheek; thou didst break the teeth of the unjust.
To Jehovah salvation: upon thy people thy blessing. Silence.
